interface_adapter.hardware_readiness: requires CDC/protocol verification and board pin assignment before programming hardware
interface_adapter.scope: FPGA only; ASIC uses the original core top module.
interface_adapter.transaction_model: MSB-first byte-aligned full-duplex frames; command N commits when CS rises and response N is read in frame N+2.

policy: Never invent physical pins. Unmapped I/O is explicit; Explorer uses core-only implementation while Prototyping blocks until every physical I/O is verified.
